featured_reviews.review_text:
Airborne has been around for five years and I have been working out with them for three years. I have been practising aerial fitness and CrossFit here. Also started with stick mobility recently.

The studio offers a variety of fitness programs. A team of trained professionals ensures that you are being taught correctly and taken care of.

What I love the most about training here is that it is a happy, safe space with a sense of belongingness. Conventional gyms or workout studios generally lack warmth. There's a formal trainer-client relationship. However at Airborne, Zamina Ladiwala and Dharmesh Chheda have successfully built a community. A community that celebrates fitness together.

Head to the studio's Instagram page (airborneaerialfitness) for full details of the schedule and more details. It is an active page and the admins respond to queries posted.
